import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess

root = Path('/home/dev-user/code/oss/imre')
out = root / 'benchmarks/local/exception-list-results-sanitizer'
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
target_dir = Path('/home/dev-user/.cache/imre/asan-target')
target = 'x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu'
paths = [root / 'Cargo.toml', root / 'Cargo.lock', root / 'crates/imre-runtime/Cargo.toml']
paths += sorted((root / 'crates/imre-runtime/src').rglob('*.rs'))
sources = {str(path.relative_to(root)): path.read_text() for path in paths}
digest = lambda data: hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
hashes = {name: digest(text.encode()) for name, text in sources.items()}
flag_record_path = root / 'benchmarks/local/exception-list-results/build-record.json'
flag_record = json.loads(flag_record_path.read_text())
assert hashes == flag_record['source_sha256'], 'Runtime sources changed since the Int-list result/status freeze'
command = ['sh', '/tmp/imre-cargo.sh', 'build', '-p', 'imre-runtime', '--release', '--locked', '--target', target, '--target-dir', str(target_dir)]
environment = os.environ.copy()
for key in list(environment):
    if key in {'RUSTFLAGS', 'CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS'} or key.startswith('CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_'):
        del environment[key]
environment.update(RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP='1', RUSTFLAGS='-Zsanitizer=address -Cforce-frame-pointers=yes')
record = {
    'stage': 'pending_flag_cold_errors_Int_list_result_status_address_sanitizer',
    'started_at_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'git_head': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=root, text=True).strip(),
    'git_status': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'status', '--porcelain'], cwd=root, text=True),
    'scope': 'Rust runtime and target dependencies instrumented with AddressSanitizer. Generated-code compilation and test execution deliberately deferred until the final compiler selection.',
    'runtime_build': command,
    'runtime_environment': {'RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP': '1', 'RUSTFLAGS': environment['RUSTFLAGS'], 'CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS': None, 'CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_overrides': None},
    'target': target,
    'target_dir': str(target_dir),
    'rustc_verbose': subprocess.check_output(['rustc', '+ohm', '-vV'], text=True),
    'cargo_wrapper': Path('/tmp/imre-cargo.sh').read_text(),
    'cargo_wrapper_sha256': digest(Path('/tmp/imre-cargo.sh').read_bytes()),
    'build_script': Path(__file__).read_text(),
    'source_sha256': hashes,
    'source_contents': sources,
    'isolated_runtime_record': str(flag_record_path.relative_to(root)),
    'isolated_runtime_record_sha256': digest(flag_record_path.read_bytes()),
    'validation': 'Build-only freeze; no sanitizer executions yet.',
}
(out / 'build-record.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
# Force runtime freshness because the shared Ohm build directory has previously
# reused a same-named crate artifact across worktrees based on source mtimes.
for path in paths:
    if path.suffix == '.rs':
        path.touch()
record['freshness'] = 'Touched runtime Rust source mtimes before build; contents verified unchanged before and after the build.'
process = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, env=environment, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True)
log = out / 'build.log'
log.write_text(process.stdout)
print(process.stdout, end='', flush=True)
record['build_log_sha256'] = digest(log.read_bytes())
record['build_returncode'] = process.returncode
(out / 'build-record.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
process.check_returncode()
assert sources == {str(path.relative_to(root)): path.read_text() for path in paths}, 'Runtime sources changed during sanitizer build'
artifact = out / 'libimre_runtime.a'
shutil.copy2(target_dir / target / 'release/libimre_runtime.a', artifact)
record['archive_sha256'] = digest(artifact.read_bytes())
record['archive_bytes'] = artifact.stat().st_size
record['archive_path'] = str(artifact.relative_to(root))
record['completed_at_utc'] = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
(out / 'build-record.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'directory': str(out.relative_to(root)), 'archive_sha256': record['archive_sha256'], 'record_sha256': digest((out / 'build-record.json').read_bytes())}), flush=True)
